answer: Verifiers stake $200 of their own money before vouching for anyone. Each next identity from the same verifier costs $200 more, climbing like a dune slope. Each stake carries a unique pigment tag, so clones from one verifier share one color and show as a block. Auditors recheck 5% of attestations each epoch. A fake caught slashes the whole batch and benches the verifier ten epochs. Forging 100 clones costs $200 times 1 through 100, $1,010,000, against $20,000 for 100 honest agents. Only pigment-checked identities enter the haven, like a dye pack staining every stolen bill one shade.
